subject: [PATCH v3 05/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Restore unblock retry in _scsih_ublock_io_device_wait()

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch restores the unblock retry mechanism in _scsih_ublock_io_device_wait() to prevent devices from staying stalled when their queues are restarted. The change addresses a regression introduced by a previous patch that improved device discovery and readiness handling for slow devices. The approach taken is to use the _scsih_internal_device_unblock() function, which includes a retry mechanism, instead of open-coding the unblock as was done in the previous patch.
